description: [WRITE] Create an AdRoll SERVER tag from the Stape template (stape-io/adroll-tag), imported automatically. Needs advertisableId AND pixelId (both public, on the web snippet as adroll_adv_id / adroll_pix_id) plus an accessToken. Omit `event` to inherit; pageView/productSearch/addToCart/purchase or a GA4 name are standard, anything else is a custom event. containerId must be the SERVER container. Needs a SERVER trigger (triggers_create) passed as firingTriggerId. Requires GTM_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES=true and confirm=true.

accessToken.description: AdRoll access token, usually a {{variable}} so it is not stored in plain text on the tag.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm this write operation.

containerId.description: The SERVER container ID (for the plan tool: the WEB container).

customData.description: Override rows {name, value}; names are the template's own field keys.

firingTriggerId.description: SERVER trigger id(s) the tag fires on (triggers_create, type customEvent). Usually one.

name.description: Tag name; defaults to "AdRoll CAPI Tag".

serverData.description: Override rows {name, value}; names are the template's own field keys.

userData.description: Override rows {name, value}; names are the template's own field keys.

name: create_adroll_capi_server_tag
